seo_title: Find Scholarships for International Students with August Deadlines
seo_description: Explore 31 scholarships for international students with August deadlines. Apply now to secure your funding for education abroad!
h1: Scholarships for International Students with August Deadlines
intro: If you're an international student seeking financial assistance for your studies, you're in the right place. With 31 scholarships available that have deadlines in August, you can find opportunities tailored to your needs. From the Vanna Christian Sun Legacy Scholarship to the Anderson Engineering Scholarship, these awards cater to various fields and backgrounds. Whether you’re pursuing engineering, public service, or STEM, there’s likely a scholarship that fits your profile. Don’t miss out on these valuable funding options; start your applications today to enhance your educational journey abroad.
supporting: Eligibility for these scholarships varies, but many are open to international students enrolled in accredited programs. For instance, the Lyndsey Scott Coding+ Scholarship focuses on students in technology fields, while the Jeannine Schroeder Women in Public Service Memorial Scholarship supports women pursuing public service careers. Most applications require a personal statement, academic transcripts, and letters of recommendation. Be sure to check each scholarship's specific requirements and deadlines. To maximize your chances, tailor your application to highlight your unique experiences and aspirations. Remember, August is just around the corner, so start preparing your materials now!
related_intro: In addition to scholarships with August deadlines, there are numerous other funding opportunities available throughout the year. Keep exploring to find the perfect match for your educational goals.
